public.title: Min Stack
public.description: Process a fresh stack using ["push",integer], ["pop"], ["top"], and ["getMin"]. Return one output per operation: null for push or pop, the top value for top, and the smallest stored value for getMin. Pop and queries occur only when nonempty. Values are -1000000 to 1000000; there are 0 to 1000 operations. There is no constructor operation. Aim for O(1) time per operation.
hints: Store the minimum alongside every stack depth.
Duplicate minimum values need separate depth entries.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: A parallel minimum stack records the minimum at each depth and restores it after pop. O(1) per operation and O(n) space.
